subject: Renewal QBR + Roadmap demo — booking & attendee alignment
messages:
From: Alex McKenna <alex@heliumhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR + expansion roadmap — timing request

Hi Irene / Marissa —

We’re approaching our renewal window and Helium Health would like to combine the renewal QBR with a short expansion/roadmap demo focused on multi-model routing and cost controls. Primary goals for our side: 1) validate performance targets for our production workload, 2) review potential Dedicated capacity options, and 3) align on next steps for procurement and SSO.

Can we book a 45–60 minute session in the week of Aug 24? Our core group is: myself, Claire Ramos (Director, Data Platform), and Priya Shah (Procurement). We need a slot that works for US Pacific mornings (to accommodate our east-coast customers later in the day).

Suggested windows (PDT):
- Tue Aug 25: 9:30–11:30am
- Wed Aug 26: 10:00–12:00pm
- Thu Aug 27: 9:00–10:30am

If those don't work, happy to take a couple alternative slots from your side. Also: can you surface a brief agenda and who from Redwood will present?

Thanks — looking forward.

Alex McKenna
Director, Cloud Engineering
Helium Health
alex@heliumhealth.com

[Attachment: example_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet) referenced]

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Alex McKenna <alex@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + expansion roadmap — timing request

Thanks Alex — this is perfect context.

High level: we can cover performance baselines, Dedicated capacity options (including burst/backfill), and a live roadmap demo that highlights routing, quantization tradeoffs, and the Optimize suggestions for cost/perf. I’ll own the QBR kickoff and Marissa will do the roadmap demo; Rishi will be available to speak to capacity and the renewal commercial outline.

Proposed firm windows (PDT) that work on our side:
- Tue Aug 25: 10:00–11:00am (tight but workable)
- Wed Aug 26: 10:30–11:30am (preferable)
- Thu Aug 27: 9:00–10:00am

Can you confirm preferred slot and whether Claire / Priya will join the demo portion or prefer a separate procurement sync afterwards? I’ve attached a short agenda (QBR_agenda_v2.docx) — please review and flag any additions.

If Wed 10:30 is good I’ll send the calendar invite and a short pre-read (SOW draft + cost estimates) for Priya.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai

[Attachment: QBR_agenda_v2.docx]

If Priya wants a procurement-only call, we can route that to our commercial ops and provide a clean SOW + pricing worksheet.

—Rishi

Wed Aug 26 at 10:30am PDT works for us — please lock it. Claire will join the full session; Priya will join the first 30 minutes for commercial/contract items then drop off for the demo.

I’ve attached our attendee list and a short note on the production workload we’ll want to validate (token distribution, peak TPS windows). Also flagged items we'd like covered in the SOW: data residency options, audit log retention, and disaster recovery RTO targets.

Can you share a tentative calendar invite + the SOW draft before EOD Monday so Priya has time to review?

Thanks — Alex
